qualifier: phorbol ester, ionomycin and lysosphingolipid receptor activation
name: Protein kinase C signaling via phorbol esters and lysosphingolipid receptors
rationale: Members are PKC and lipid second-messenger signaling (PMA, ionomycin, S1P/LPA receptors, lipid phosphorylation, PRKCZ); unlike confusables centred on G beta:gamma-PLC/IP3 calcium or BCR signaling, this theme carries the phorbol ester/ionomycin and S1P-receptor arms.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA and AMPK regulation
name: Glycogen and glucose metabolism under glucagon-PKA control
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown and storage diseases, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis via hexose phosphates; confusables share the carbohydrate core but lack the glucagon-PKA, AMPK-ChREBP and lactate/fermentation regulatory members.

qualifier: Rho, Rnd and Cdc42 subfamilies with formin activation
name: Rho, Rnd and Cdc42 GTPase cycles
rationale: All members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C/D/F, RND2/3, CDC42, RHOU/V and formin activation; confusables add RAC/RHOG cycles or actin-protrusion processes that this theme lacks.

qualifier: erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and Rhesus glycoproteins
name: Erythrocyte gas exchange and Rhesus-mediated ammonium transport
rationale: Members are erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and Rh-glycoprotein ammonium/CO2 transport; confusables are bicarbonate transport or Rh blood-group biosynthesis and anemia without the gas-exchange reactions.

qualifier: neural plate, hindbrain and craniofacial-pharyngeal derivatives
name: Embryonic neural plate, hindbrain and craniofacial-pharyngeal patterning
rationale: Members span neural plate/border and rhombomere specification, dorsoventral axis, craniofacial, pharyngeal-organ and limb morphogenesis; confusables share craniofacial organs but lack the neural plate, hindbrain HOX and axis-specification members.

qualifier: SREBP sterol and ChREBP glucose sensing
name: SREBP sterol and ChREBP glucose-responsive transcription
rationale: Members are SREBP-driven cholesterol gene expression and glucose/ChREBP-driven transcription; confusables are glucagon-PKA/AMPK, ATF6/CREB3 or nuclear-receptor programmes lacking SREBP motifs and glucose-sensing transcription together.

qualifier: cardiac contraction, relaxation and heart rate
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in cardiac contractility
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium uptake/release (SERCA, ryanodine receptor, Na/Ca exchange) and resulting cardiac force, relaxation and rate; confusables address plasma-membrane calcium flux, fiber-type or caffeine/calcium responses instead.

core: Nuclear receptor control of fasting metabolism
qualifier: PPAR-alpha, gluconeogenesis and triglyceride homeostasis
name: PPAR-alpha-driven fasting control of gluconeogenesis and triglycerides
rationale: Members are fatty-acid/caloric-restriction responses regulating gluconeogenesis, triglyceride and mitochondrial biogenesis via PPARA and LXR; confusables emphasise SREBP/lipogenesis, circadian or adipose lipolysis programmes.

qualifier: right ventricle and morphogenetic apoptosis
name: Cardiac ventricle formation and morphogenetic apoptosis
rationale: All three members concern forming the (right) ventricle including apoptosis in heart morphogenesis; confusables cover heart-field specification, trabeculation/compaction or valve and septum formation.

core: Endosomal receptor recycling to the cell surface
qualifier: Rab/Arf-regulated, including postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors
name: Rab/Arf-regulated endosomal recycling of surface and postsynaptic receptors
rationale: Members control endocytosis versus recycling of surface receptors through Rab/Arf GTPase signaling, including postsynaptic receptor trafficking; confusables are clathrin cargo recognition, presynaptic organisation or Golgi secretion.

core: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling and clearance
qualifier: intestinal lipid absorption and vitamin E transport
name: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL assembly, LDL/HDL remodeling and clearance and intestinal lipid and sterol absorption; confusables share lipoprotein biology but carry HDL assembly and cholesterol efflux rather than intestinal absorption and vitamin E transport.

qualifier: ascorbate supply and oxidative enzyme modification
name: Ascorbate transport and oxidative extracellular matrix modification
rationale: Members link ascorbate/dehydroascorbate transport and metabolism to oxidative ECM processing (collagen crosslinking, basement membrane, hyaluronan degradation, arylsulfatase activation); confusables are vitamin C responses, sulfation cofactors or collagen/integrin assembly without the ascorbate-oxidation link.

qualifier: gap junction electrical coupling
name: Gap junction coupling in cardiac conduction
rationale: All members concern cell-cell electrical coupling via gap junctions in cardiac conduction; confusables cover conduction-system development, action-potential depolarisation or calcium-handling contraction.

core: Central nervous system vascular barrier formation
qualifier: retinal vasculature and FZD4 signaling
name: Retinal vascular and blood-brain/retinal barrier development
rationale: Members are retinal vessel morphogenesis, blood-brain and blood-retinal barrier establishment, RPE development and FZD4 signaling; confusables are lens/eye morphogenesis or placental development lacking the barrier members.

qualifier: renal sodium-chloride transport and aldosterone
name: Osmotic stress response and renal sodium-chloride transport
rationale: Members are hyper/hypo-osmotic sensing, water homeostasis and renal sodium/chloride transport under aldosterone; confusables are potassium-coupled ion transport or vasopressin-aquaporin water handling.

qualifier: deadenylation, decapping and 5'-3' exonuclease, P-bodies
name: Cytoplasmic mRNA deadenylation, decapping and 5'-3' decay
rationale: Members are poly(A) shortening, decapping, 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay and P-body assembly; confusables are miRNA silencing, ARE-binding protein destabilisation, 3'-end processing or mRNA stabilisation.

core: NAD and adenine nucleotide metabolism and transport
qualifier: mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocase, viral apoptosis
name: NAD salvage and mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocase transport
rationale: Members are nicotinate/NAD salvage and catabolism plus mitochondrial ATP/ADP/NAD transport, including viral apoptosis through the translocase; confusables are tryptophan-kynurenine NAD synthesis or nucleotide interconversion without the transport and viral apoptosis members.

qualifier: synthesis-dependent strand annealing and sister chromatid exchange
name: Recombinational DSB repair via strand annealing and sister exchange
rationale: Members are repair DNA synthesis, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange and mitotic recombination; confusables are telomere recombination, Fanconi/BRCA responses or break-induced replication and checkpoints.

qualifier: platelet activation, coagulation cascade and fibrinolysis
name: Platelet activation, coagulation cascade and fibrinolysis
rationale: Members cover platelet receptor signaling, adhesion and degranulation, coagulation factor activation and defects, and fibrinolysis; confusables are vitamin K carboxylation, integrin-MAPK linkage or eicosanoid synthesis.

core: Steroid hormone and fat-soluble vitamin metabolism
qualifier: vitamins A, D and K
name: Steroidogenesis and fat-soluble vitamin A, D, K metabolism
rationale: Members are cytochrome P450 steroid hormone biosynthesis and retinoid, vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism; confusables cover only the steroid side with thyroid/pituitary hormones, phosphate-mineral handling, or the visual retinoid cycle.

qualifier: cAMP-PKA and CaMK cascades with MECP2 regulation
name: Neuronal cAMP-PKA and CaMK-CREB signaling with MECP2
rationale: Members are adenylate cyclase/PKA and CaMK routes to CREB, MECP2 regulation and memory; confusables are NMDA/AMPA receptor plasticity programmes lacking the cAMP-PKA and MECP2 members.

qualifier: transcriptional control of cadherins and EMT
name: Cadherin gene regulation in epithelial identity and EMT
rationale: Members regulate CDH1/CDH11/CDH19 expression, cadherin adhesion and EMT within epithelial programmes; confusables concern adherens junction assembly, cadherin trafficking/degradation or delamination.

qualifier: ABCD1 adrenoleukodystrophy
name: Very long-chain acyl-CoA degradation and adrenoleukodystrophy
rationale: All members concern catabolism of very long-chain acyl-CoAs, including ABCD1 defects; confusables are VLCFA synthesis, peroxisomal beta-oxidation enzymes or peroxisome protein import.

qualifier: lamina depolymerization and envelope reformation
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope and lamina disassembly and reformation
rationale: Members are nuclear lamina/membrane disassembly and reassembly in mitosis; confusables are ESCRT-III sealing and abscission or nuclear pore complex assembly and transport.

core: Ribosome biogenesis and nuclear RNA processing
qualifier: pre-rRNA cleavage and exosome RNA surveillance
name: Pre-rRNA processing and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA surveillance
rationale: Members are pre-rRNA cleavage/trimming and methylation, snoRNA/snRNA 3'-end processing and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA decay; confusables are RNA base modification, tRNA processing or telomerase/Cajal body functions.
